rule: Defect-family labels are bounded mechanism results, not statistically independent replicates or empirical defect-frequency estimates.

defects.fault: rejected candidate mutates committed physical state
defects.b2_effect: authoritative physical storage is private and public snapshots are detached clones
defects.b1_relationship: no executable public-API contamination mutant exists for the frozen direct write-through fault
defects.scientific_fixture: real Reference post-solver rejection control plus public-API structural probes
defects.primary_limit: does not establish earlier or unique detection against B1

defects.fault: rejected attempt is counted in an accepted side ledger before successful re-execution
defects.b2_effect: detects nonzero accepted accounting at retry entry
defects.b1_relationship: detects accepted-total mismatch only after the accepted retry; net mass closure can remain green
defects.scientific_fixture: real Reference Richards rejected long trial and accepted short re-execution
defects.primary_limit: one bounded flux/regime fixture; not unique detection

defects.fault: wrong-lineage, stale-revision or wrong-time-origin candidate is committed
defects.b2_effect: public commit contract rejects invalid provenance before committed mutation
defects.b1_relationship: invalid commit is prevented rather than diagnosed downstream
defects.scientific_fixture: public kernel transaction contract with valid and invalid-origin candidates
defects.primary_limit: contract-level evidence; not a hydrologic-regime replication

defects.fault: speculative candidate physical state is serialized as accepted continuation state
defects.b2_effect: detects candidate-derived restart payload before publication
defects.b1_relationship: strong restart round-trip detects mismatch after faulty artifact restore; downstream continuation can diverge while local mass remains green
defects.primary_limit: synthetic bounded physical state rather than a full SWAP hydrologic trajectory

defects.channel: numerical workspace versus physical retry origin
defects.fault: rejected-trial Newton workspace old_head is promoted to physical retry state
defects.b2_effect: detects workspace-derived retry origin before the retry solve
defects.b1_relationship: detects endpoint/storage divergence after the retry solve
defects.scientific_fixture: real B01 Reference Richards solver with full-step versus half-step rejection context
defects.primary_limit: single material/state/forcing fixture; not unique detection

defects.fault: candidate-side directional result is externally emitted as accepted while outer transaction is rejected
defects.b2_effect: rejects publication before irreversible observer emission because outer transaction is not accepted with one commit
defects.b1_relationship: detects nonzero accepted-publication count after the rejected operation, after external contamination already occurred
defects.scientific_fixture: admitted accepted-trajectory publication stack with deterministic candidate-side direction scratch
defects.primary_limit: publication lifecycle fixture, not hydrologic sensitivity-accuracy evidence

negative_evidence.meaning: clean continuation did not accept under the frozen configuration; settings were not tuned post-result
selected historical retry harness could not be reproduced on current dependencies; the harness was not rebuilt until positive
later parallel publication surface closed after earlier D6 authority PR215 was admitted; no post-result surface selection

cross_defect_conclusion.interpretation: Explicit transition authority shows bounded prevention/localization value across multiple consequence channels. It has not shown that strong conventional qualification ultimately misses the executable seeded faults.
